subject: Acme vendor form & PO line-item mapping for per-token commits
messages:
From: Jared Cole <jared.cole@acme.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Vendor form + PO mapping questions

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked Redwood's latency numbers. Our procurement team has pushed back on the hosted API pricing model. They said they can’t sign an open-ended per-token invoice without a clear PO that maps to committed line items.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
- Accept our preferred vendor form (attached) rather than your standard quote sheet?
- Provide an example PO with line items that map to "committed tokens" and an overage rate?
- Support a monthly cap or prepayment model instead of pure post-usage billing?

Attached: Acme_Vendor_Form.pdf and our PO_Template.xlsx for reference.

Procurement also asked for Redwood's tax ID and whether you can provide a W-9 (or local equivalent). Please advise.

Thanks,
Jared Cole
Head of Procurement
Acme Corp
--- attachment: Acme_Vendor_Form.pdf (application/pdf)
--- attachment: PO_Template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@acme.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 16:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Vendor form + PO mapping questions

Hi Jared — thanks for sending the form. I’ve looped in Rishi (sales lead) and Vivek (finance/enterprise sales) to help. Quick answers up front: Redwood primarily bills hosted API usage as per-token usage with tiered volume discounts, but we can be flexible on how that billing maps to your PO.

Options we commonly offer:
1) Committed tokens: Customer commits to N tokens/month at a discounted per-token rate; we invoice monthly for committed volume. Overages billed at a higher per-token rate, with a 30-day true-up.
2) Monthly cap/prepay: Customer prepays a capped monthly amount that draws down as usage occurs. If draw exceeds cap, overage logic or temporary throttling can apply depending on agreement.
3) Invoiced commit with line items: We can surface committed units as explicit PO line items (e.g., "Committed tokens — Tier A — 1,000,000 tokens @ $0.0008/token").

I’m attaching a short summary of our commit tiers and discount curves. Please let us know which of the three is acceptable to Acme procurement and which fields on your vendor form are non-negotiable for legal/finance (e.g., payment terms, PO number, tax ID).

We can accept the preferred vendor form as an exhibit to the MSA in many cases; legal will want to confirm a few mapping points. Happy to schedule a quick 30-minute call with procurement and our finance/legal owners.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0189
--- attachment: redwood_commit_tiers_summary.pdf (application/pdf)

From: procurement@acme.com <procurement@acme.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:47:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Vendor form + PO mapping questions

Olga — appreciate the options. Procurement requires the preferred vendor form be fully completed and executed; finance will only approve a PO against a vendor form they have on file. A few constraints we have:
- We cannot accept an open per-token billing model without explicit PO line items tied to a committed quantity or prepayment.
- Payment terms requested: Net-45 is preferred.
- Each PO must include the vendor's legal name, tax ID, and invoice remit address.
- We need example PO lines to show to our AP team — nothing quoted in the abstract.

Can you produce an example PO that shows committed tokens broken into line items or confirm Redwood will accept a prepayment (monthly or quarterly) and then provide usage reconciliation?

Jared Cole
Head of Procurement, Acme Corp
--- note: attached earlier vendor form

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@acme.com>
Cc: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Vendor form + PO mapping questions

Hi Jared — thanks, good to meet you over email. I want to propose a concrete commercial structure that should satisfy Acme's AP and procurement controls while keeping billing manageable for both sides.

Proposed commercial terms (summary):
- Committed plan: 12-month commitment of 250M tokens/month at $0.00075/token (committed), 20% discount applied to committed volume.
- Overage: $0.0012/token above committed usage, invoiced monthly with 30-day true-up.
- Billing & POs: We will accept Acme's preferred vendor form attached as Exhibit A to the MSA. The PO can list two line items: 1) "Committed tokens — Monthly allocation (250,000,000 tokens) @ $0.00075/token" and 2) "Overage — variable usage @ $0.0012/token (billed monthly)."
- Payment terms: Net-45 acceptable pending a quick credit check.
- Tax & remittance: Redwood's legal name and tax id can be provided; finance will also include Redwood's invoice remit address on the vendor form.

I’m attaching a quick mapping spreadsheet showing how Acme's PO_Template fields would map to Redwood invoice fields. If procurement needs a different layout, we can adapt it into your PO_Template.

If that structure works, Olga will introduce you to our legal and billing contact to execute the vendor form and provide a sample PO for AP.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
--- attachment: redwood_vendor_mapping.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Jared Cole <jared.cole@acme.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, procurement@acme.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:08:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Vendor form + PO mapping questions

Rishi — thanks for the clear proposal. A couple of follow-ups from AP before we proceed:
1) Can you provide an actual sample PO (PDF) using our PO_Template.xlsx with the two line items. AP needs that to route the vendor record creation.
2) Net-45 is fine, but our legal wants to see the vendor form language around indemnity and data handling — can you confirm Redwood will accept the vendor form as an exhibit and that any conflicting terms will be handled in the MSA exhibit?
3) We will need a W-9 (or UK equivalent) and Redwood's tax ID to complete vendor creation.

If you can get the sample PO + W-9 and the vendor form mapping, we’ll move to vendor creation and issue a PO.

Regards,
Jared

From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
